rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a naturally occurring mineral as a substance or scientific category.

example.english: This mineral formed underground over thousands of years.
example.traditional: 呢種礦物喺地底形成咗幾千年。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 gwong3 mat6 hai2 dei6 dai2 jing4 sing4 zo2 gei2 cin1 nin4

rows.note: Use this specifically for an inorganic nutrient needed by the body, such as iron or calcium.

example.english: Milk contains plenty of mineral nutrients.
example.jyutping: ngau4 naai5 ham4 jau5 fung1 fu3 gwong3 mat6 zat1

rows.note: Use this specifically for mineral water as a drink.

example.english: Mineral water is the most refreshing drink in summer.
example.jyutping: haa6 tin1 jam2 gwong3 cyun4 seoi2 zeoi3 gaai2 hot3
